_comment: Tree Surgery v1 settings. Model IDs, token limits, openers and email wording live here, not in code. appVersion matches the PRD version and prints on the record.
footer: {COURSE} practice tool. Feedback is AI-generated; you remain responsible for your work.
_modelsNote: Thinking is always on for these models and its tokens count against maxTokens. At about 100 tokens a second each call must finish inside functionBudgetSeconds; tune in the pilot (spec §7.1). reviewTree is the review's Part A (findings) and reviewEmail its Part B (the email), two calls since D24.
_budgetNote: Netlify stops this project's functions at about 26-30 seconds (QT D21), so the app's own timeout comes first.
_keyQuestionNote: Attempts per round. After the last Not OK in a round the student reworks and comes back with a new key question (spec D16).
_emailCheckNote: Chris set a hard ceiling of 250 words on every email (spec D17).

openers.keyQuestion: The key question needs rethinking. Send back to me when you have reworked the tree with a new question.
openers.firstCut: The first cut needs rethinking. Send back to me when you have reworked it.
openers.rework: Good start, but the tree needs some rework. Send back to me for a quick check when done.
openers.pass: Well structured tree. Go ahead and use this to develop the workplan.
openers.signedOff: Signed off. Use this to develop the workplan.
openers.notThereYet: Not there yet. Take what's left to the team session.

briefing.subject: Your issue tree: key question first
paragraphs: Before the team problem-solving session, I want each of you to draft your own issue tree on the key question the team agreed.

Send me your key question first, with your first-level sub-questions if they carry the target. Once we've agreed it, send me your draft issue tree before the team session: one page, in our template, to four levels below the key question, with the agreed key question at the root.
Attach the client brief or your notes too, so I can see the client's situation.

keyQuestionOk.subject: Re: your key question
paragraphs: That Key Question will work to structure the tree.

unreadable.subject: Re: your issue tree – can't read it
unreadable.before: I can't read the tree you sent.
unreadable.after: Send it to me again as one clear page, in our template.

reasons.blurred: The page is too blurred to read the boxes.
reasons.several_trees: There's more than one tree on the page, so I can't tell which is yours.
reasons.not_a_tree: I can't see an issue tree on that page.
reasons.too_small: The text is too small to read.
reasons.other: I can't follow the structure on that page.
